name: labs/rwb27__openflexure_microscope_software
title: OpenFlexure Microscope (openflexure_microscope.microscope:Microscope)
intro: OpenFlexure Microscope (openflexure_microscope.microscope:Microscope), adapted from rwb27/openflexure_microscope_software. It reads `resolution`, `shutter_speed` and `awb_mode`; sets `zoom`; runs `autofocus_scan`. `autofocus_scan`: run the microscope's autofocus over stage z positions and report the sharpness at each. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
